senses.gloss:
अप्न, अस्, m. or अप्नस्, अस्, n., Ved. possession,
property; work, sacrificial act; progeny; shape [cf.
Lat. ops].
—अप्नह्-स्थ, अस्, m., Ved. superintending
work.
—अप्न-राज्, ट्, m., Ved. possessing property;
illustrious through work.
—अप्नस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. productive, having sacrificial acts or work.

अप्नवान, अस् m., Ved. having progeny; the
arm; N. of a Ṛṣi; poor (?).
